items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee lists 'Bumps Meyers' in a sequence of names of musicians he knew or jammed with (e.g., 'And another fella, excellent guitar player, John Collins. ... ... Bumps Meyers ...'), but provides no specific details about a direct interaction, collaboration, or personal relationship with Meye

ctx.x: Did you play with Lester Young out there?

Sure, I used to go to his house every day. Lester had a thousand records I guess. And he sit up there and play all day every day. He loved his play, he loved his horn. I used to go out to his house. --- He lived on the other side of town --- I had a little old Ford. --- He and what's the bass players name, Charles? Best bass player in New York. Fight all the time. --- We used to get together and jam.
